content: Because you are alive, everything is possible.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh
sourceWork: Thich Nhat Hanh's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Thich Nhat Hanh's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of life and mindfulness. Across his life and work, Thich Nhat Hanh returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where can you bring full, undistracted presence into an ordinary routine or conversation today?
